articles.title: Rafale makes first landing on INS Vikrant aircraft carrier: Watch video
articles.summary: A Rafale Marine fighter jet successfully completed its historic first-ever landing on India's indigenous aircraft carrier, INS Vikrant, on October 29. This significant trial marks a major milestone for India's naval aviation capabilities, demonstrating the carrier's operational readiness and the seamless integration of advanced fighter technology with domestically built defence infrastructure.

articles.title: Russian strikes leave 200,000 without power in Ukraine
articles.summary: Russian attacks have left over 200,000 people without power in Ukraine's central Dnipropetrovsk region. This disruption follows a deadly Russian drone strike on a train station in the area. The incidents underscore the continued targeting of critical infrastructure and civilian areas amidst the ongoing conflict, highlighting the severe humanitarian impact and geopolitical tensions in Eastern Europe.

articles.title: Omron Healthcare eyes Chennai as global manufacturing hub, targets 3 million BP monitors by 2028
articles.summary: Japanese Omron Healthcare, a major producer of blood pressure monitors and nebulisers, plans to establish Chennai as a strategic manufacturing hub. This facility will produce and supply healthcare devices to international markets. The initiative aims to leverage India's manufacturing capabilities, boost exports, and strengthen Chennai's position as a global production base for medical technology, representing significant foreign investment.
